description: Check before you hire or pay an ERC-8004 agent on Base: its track record and fraud check in one call. Returns the verdict (LEGIT, SUS or BOUNCED: honesty), a 0-100 score from paid escrow work and clean reviews (quality; null when bounced or no clean record), fraud flags with onchain receipts, and stats. When activated, paid_per_use separately reports the payer-only score and stats; category labels and risk notes never affect scores. Use it for due diligence before you delegate work, send an x402 payment or trust an agent's reviews. Read the verdict first. Takes an id (base:14516, moltlaunch:0x…); call find_agent first if you only have a name or a wallet. Free within the per-IP allowance.

id.description: Agent id, e.g. base:14516 or moltlaunch:0x… (seed:… are test cases).

track.description: Opt in to an outcome link (needs a pass): records that your pass's wallet checked this agent, so the outcomes tool can later show your escrow jobs with it. Nothing else is stored.

name: check_agent

category.description: Non-scoring label from existing research or verified Bazaar tags; absent when unknown.

category_note.description: Risk disclaimer for trading, DeFi, prediction markets and airdrops.

description.description: Enhanced description combining research and available Bazaar claims (paid agent pages/export only).

description_bazaar.description: Paid only. Up to three matched Bazaar claims and provenance; first claim supplies the public preview.

description_note.description: Free response only: paid-access note, or null when no enhanced profile exists.

description_preview.description: One sentence from a verified-linked Bazaar listing; provider claim, unverified. Never research text.

description_research.description: Paid only. Supplied research findings, including identity caveats and their date; never scoring evidence.

usdc_atomic_clean.description: Clean USDC in exact atomic units (6 decimals).

title: Check an agent
